channel.title: The Coin Wire
channel.description: Crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation and protocol upgrades: what changed, and what comes next.

item.title: SEC staff backs Molecule’s research-token model on stated terms
item.description: The SEC staff’s conditional response covers LabsCo’s proposed token sales, separating research access and advisory input from any later, independently offered equity.

item.title: How to Simulate a Transaction Before Signing It for a Bridge Transfer
item.description: A transaction simulation runs the proposed call against current chain state and previews its expected effects before you sign. For a bridge transfer, that…

item.title: How to find a token contract address in Phantom for a rugcheck
item.description: To find a Solana token contract address in Phantom, open the token and copy its mint address; verify it in Solscan before using it for a risk check.

item.title: Bitcoin Change Outputs: Where the Leftover BTC Goes
item.description: What is a change output in a Bitcoin transaction? It returns leftover BTC to an address you control after the payment and miner fee are accounted for.

item.title: How to Limit Sandwich Loss on a DEX Swap
item.description: How does a sandwich attack work on a DEX swap? A bot trades before and after your order to profit from a worse fill. Tight slippage and private routing reduce exposure.

item.title: How many slices should a TWAP order use for a large trade?
item.description: How many slices should a TWAP order use for a large crypto trade? Start with a tolerable slice size, then check the interval and execution costs.

item.title: stETH vs rETH vs cbETH: which fits restaking?
item.description: stETH vs rETH vs cbETH for restaking comes down to AVS acceptance, issuer trust and exits: stETH is the default, rETH favors permissionless operators, cbETH suits Coinbase exits.

item.title: BlackRock opens Hong Kong tokenized fund with $100 million
item.description: BlackRock’s HKD fund opened with $100 million, pairing blockchain-recorded units and HKDAP settlement with a conventional money-market portfolio.

item.title: EU proposal widens Russia crypto sanctions to third countries
item.description: The EU's proposed 22nd Russia package widens crypto enforcement to payment networks and third countries, but all 27 members must approve it before it takes effect.

item.title: EU proposes wider crypto sanctions in 22nd Russia package
item.description: The Commission’s 22nd Russia sanctions proposal would extend bank and crypto restrictions, but member-state approval is still needed before measures take effect.

item.title: Suibridge: Checks Before You Bridge From Your Wallet
item.description: Suibridge risks before bridging from your own wallet: verify the site, token, address, gas and approval; save the Ethereum transaction hash to trace it.

item.title: Chainlist: Add an EVM Network to Your Wallet
item.description: seo_title: Chainlist add network step by step: approve and verify

item.title: DOJ gets authority over $1.2B in Binance theft
item.description: US secured court authority to seize or restrain $1.2 billion of Binance's stolen crypto, while $2.7 billion is frozen and recovery efforts continue.

item.title: DBS adds 24/7 USDC access for Asian institutions
item.description: DBS and Circle will let eligible Asian institutions mint and redeem USDC with 24/7 dollar settlement, giving them a bank route alongside secondary markets.

item.title: Visa takes stablecoin prefunding pilots into Asia-Pacific
item.description: Visa will pilot stablecoin prefunding for Asia-Pacific payouts with dtcpay, letting eligible businesses fund transfers digitally while recipients continue to receive fiat.

item.title: How does credit delegation work in Aave V3 forks?
item.description: Credit delegation lets a borrower use your collateral through a debt-token allowance; the borrower receives funds, while the delegator carries the debt and liquidation risk.

item.title: DEX Interfaces and On-Chain Trade Settlement
item.description: What a DEX interface does versus the protocol behind it: the app shapes your order and quote; smart contracts enforce the rules and settle token transfers.

item.title: Which crypto bridging mistakes cost users time or funds?
item.description: Common mistakes to avoid when bridging crypto: match the network and address, fund gas on both chains, use a trusted link, limit approval, and verify the token contract.

item.title: Impermanent Loss Recovery at the Entry Price Ratio
item.description: Does impermanent loss go away if price comes back? Yes: in a 50/50 constant-product pool, it returns to zero when the token-price ratio returns to entry.

item.title: LayerZero Scan Inflight Status: What Your Transfer Is Waiting For
item.description: LayerZero Scan inflight status meaning: the source transaction sent the message, but Berachain has not verified and executed it yet; see which stage is waiting.
